reviews.review:
Good enough.

Completely lacks any attempts at horror and tension (which, contrary to what some fans say, was a major part of Aliens, and if you don't believe me rewatch the movie and count the amount and length of action scenes - I did), but despite of that manages to be a fun and slightly campy coop horde shooter that pays more than enough homage to the lore and style of the series to satisfy most Alien maniacs regardless of their prefered canon interpretation.

The gameplay itself can get repetetive after a while, you mostly run forward with your finger on the trigger. A bigger focus on tension would shake this up pretty well, unfortunately this wasn't part of the game's core vision. Thankfuly Fireteam Elite manages to somewhat alleviate the simplicity with good progression and character customization, mission mutators, extensive (and quite cleverly implemented) skill trees et cetera.

The core gameplay, graphics and sound are all extremely "good enough". I didn't enounter any major bugs, and I genuinely enjoyed the very solid foundation this game has. On the very basic level - Moving, shooting, animations, combat, all that jazz, it feels "polished" and smooth, which is more than most indie (and some AAA) games can offer. A surprising major strength of the game is a very good and decently memorable soundtrack.

And all of that was before all of the major updates the game recieved with new game modes, weapons, customization items, not to mention an upcoming major story DLC.

Back when it released it was already a solid 7/10. How is it now? I'll find out soon enough, the download is halfway through. We're in the pipe, five by five.
Had a lot of fun playing, just not a lot of content...sux
Super serious and fun to play.....
If you like the franchise and you like PvE horde mode style gameplay, this one's for you.

Really fun game, feels like being in the Aliens movie with some extra cool tech.

# Story

The story is just ok, but nice for fans of the movies.

# Gameplay

The gameplay is pretty simple, clearing waves of aliens, but that is a lot of fun.  The maps are pretty detailed and varied enough for the story.  It looks like there will be expansions too, I'm looking forward to that!

# Bugs

Not many, I got one crash so far.

I am a fan of the franchise. (AvP, Colonial Marines, Isolation) This is a Very fun game with a good team backing you up. The cross play add on makes the MP experience that much better. (I played before the cross play add on and was difficult to find players to play with).  Affect cards add a level of difficulty/ease depending on what is used. Overall when each person plays their class of warrior well, it makes for a very enjoyable experience. Good challenge on regular difficulty, looking forward to trying a harder setting.

Pros:
Good team shooter
Replay value
Fun
Weapon/Character Customisation

Cons:
Drops games during loading (I have a fiber connection so I am unsure if its a server issue or due to other players connection speed)
Sometimes Drops players in game
Can be Laggy when loading parts of stage ( I think this has to do with the same issue that causes dropped games/players)
Fun game to play. Just needs more chapters and cutscenes!
